description: This file defines multiple tools for managing GitHub gists, including listing, retrieving, creating, and updating gists, with associated handlers and schemas.

methods.name: ListGists
methods.description: Creates a tool and handler to list GitHub gists for a user, with optional filtering by username and timestamp.

methods.name: GetGist
methods.description: Creates a tool and handler to retrieve a specific gist by ID.

methods.name: CreateGist
methods.description: Creates a tool and handler to create a new gist with specified filename, content, description, and visibility.

methods.name: UpdateGist
methods.description: Creates a tool and handler to update an existing gist's description, filename, or content.
